title: refactor(driver-sql): move the schema-drift pipeline (detect, reconcile, apply) out of sql-driver.ts into sql-driver-schema-sync.ts (#25521 cut 10)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XYRE6GPE8YzTknPF34Y6dqS)_

Part of #25521
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840
Ruling-ref: 6348891160

Cut 10 of the `sql-driver.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6423425118`. The cut opens with a fresh seam table (below) and takes the area it prices best that breaks no series limit. The bodies of six `SqlDriver` methods move unedited into the existing seam module `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`, through its existing host `SchemaSyncHost`. Together they are the managed-schema drift pipeline, the code that sits on top of the reconcilers and the index machinery cuts 6, 8 and 9 already moved there:

- `detectTableDrift`, which diffs one table's columns against its physical schema;
- `detectTableIndexDrift`, which diffs that table's indexes and runs the ADR-0120 pre-flight on the result;
- `detectManagedDrift` (public), which runs the table diff over every managed table;
- `planMediaColumnMove` (public), the read-only plan of the ADR-0104 media column move;
- `reconcileAndWarnDrift`, the boot-time reconcile-or-warn;
- `applyMigrationEntries` (public), which applies a set of drift entries.

The change is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts. There is no `docs/adr/**` edit, no `packages/spec/**` edit, no anchor entry change and no new gate. Branch `claude/project-thread-5jymjn` (the platform assigned it to this card thread, as the claim records). One commit, `5fba834b4`, on `origin/main` `48fba2b178`.

**Net line count (the seat's rule).** `sql-driver.ts` goes from 20,990 lines to 20,739: **-251**.

- Out: the six bodies, 314 lines (52 + 32 + 21 + 75 + 57 + 77), and 15 import names whose last reader was a moved body (one line each).
- In: the six stub bodies, 76 lines (12 + 10 + 11 + 13 + 16 + 14, each 4 + 2 per field or getter read + 1 per method read), and 2 import-comment lines.
- Priced before the move at -238 for the bodies alone; the import names are the rest.
- The module grows from 777 to 1,154 lines.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** I read the full file list of every open PR at start (37 PRs) and again before `pr_create` (35 PRs, 17 of them new). No open PR touches `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`, `turso-driver.ts`, the drift section of `sql-driver.ts` or the driver-sql anchor entries.

- #26261 (`$now` comparand) is the one that edits `sql-driver.ts`. Its hunks are in the module preamble and in Filter helpers (`applyFilterCondition`'s operator loop and a new `applyNowAnchorComparison` beside the cross-field comparison), not in the drift section. Whichever of the two lands second merges `main`.
- #26138 touches `driver-sql/src/builtin-column-collision.ts` only, and #26267 the `vitest.config.ts` of driver-turso and driver-sqlite-wasm only. The release PR #25640 touches driver `package.json` and `CHANGELOG.md` files only.

## Seam table, fresh, on `48fba2b178`

`origin/main` is at `48fba2b178`, after cut 9 (`ab112ea8d5`).

- **Size and churn.** `sql-driver.ts` is 20,990 lines. 30-day lines are `git blame` lines from commits on or after 2026-09-26T17:15:20Z, 30 days before the base commit. I deepened history to 2026-09-18 first, and `scripts/pm/git-history.mjs count` proves 69 commits on the file in that window (27 in the last 7 days). In all, 3,202 lines (15.3%) are from the last 30 days.
- **Class shape.** `SqlDriver` spans lines 5513-20915 with 348 members: 241 instance methods (49 public), 13 accessors and 32 statics, all 32 of them private or protected. 24 of the instance methods are already stubs from cuts 1-9.
- **Inferred return types.** One public member has one: the `supports` getter, in the class head.
- **How it was measured.** A TypeScript compiler AST script, which strips casts, parentheses, `!` and `satisfies` before it reads `this`. Sections are the class's own banner comments (`// ===` blocks and `// ──` sub-banners), as cut 9 cut them; cut 9's table also folds the docblock heading "The sequence semantics a second face shares" into CRUD, and so does this one. "Methods" counts instance method declarations, without accessors.

### Pricing the eligible methods

A method is eligible to move when it meets every condition below. 168 of the 241 instance methods do (24 are already stubs, 19 build through `getBuilder`, 17 read a private static, 12 write to `this`, 3 have a `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, and one is `insertOnlyUpsertColumns`).

- Its return type is annotated, or it is not public.
- It has no `getBuilder` site, no `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, no private or protected static read, no `super` read, no bare `this` pass and no write to `this`.
- It is not `insertOnlyUpsertColumns`.

**The net-line rule.** Each candidate is priced as its stub minus its body. A stub costs 4 lines, plus 2 for each field or getter read and 1 for each method read.

## Why this area

- **It pays the most of any area that moves cleanly.** The three sections priced above it each fail on the card's own terms:
  - **Filter helpers** is where open PR #26261 is editing, so the serial rule takes it out of this cut.
  - **Rotation**'s paying bodies read eight module-local declarations that other class members also read (`SQLITE_NON_TEMPORAL_TEXT_REFS`, `isMultiValuedColumn`, `isDeferredDdlLockWaitRefusal`, `isNowDefaultValue`, `AUDIT_TIMESTAMP_COLUMNS` and more). Moving them needs exports added to `sql-driver.ts` or a helper moved away from its other callers. It is also three areas under one banner: rotation, the canonical datetime and JSON backfills, and the MySQL column migrations.
  - **CRUD**'s paying bodies are the sequence and upsert code: `SEQUENCES_TABLE` and five conflict-target helpers are module-local and shared.
- **The six bodies read no module-local declaration of `sql-driver.ts`.** Every declaration they read is imported from the module that declares it (`schema-drift.ts`, `media-column-move.ts`, `@objectstack/spec/system`) or is the exported type `IntrospectedColumn`. No `export` was added anywhere, and no helper moved.
- **They belong in an existing module and host.** `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts` already holds what this pipeline calls: `applyDriftOpInPlace` and `rebuildSqliteTablePatched` (cut 6), `applyIndexDriftOp` (cut 8), `applyNullSafeUniquePreflight` (cut 9). `SchemaSyncHost` already listed 8 of the 26 members these bodies read.
- **No series limit is touched:**
  - none of the six builds through `getBuilder`;
  - none reads a static;
  - none has a `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site (`this.driftWarned.add(` is a Set write, read through the host getter, and the tenant-audit census reads the same 243 sites at both ends);
  - none uses `super`, a bare `this` or a cast-wrapped `this`, and none writes to `this`;
  - the three public ones (`detectManagedDrift`, `planMediaColumnMove`, `applyMigrationEntries`) have annotated return types; the other three are protected.
- **Subclasses.** `TursoDriver` overrides `detectManagedDrift`, `applyMigrationEntries` and `planMediaColumnMove`, and each calls `super` on its local path. The stubs stay on the class with the same signatures, so `super` still reaches them, and the moved bodies reach every method through a late-bound closure on the instance, so Turso's `introspectColumns`, `introspectIndexes` and `applyMigrationEntries` overrides are still the ones that run. One driver-sql test (`sql-driver-11722-sqlite-rebuild-applied-honesty.test.ts`) overrides `detectTableDrift` in a subclass; it passes at both ends, and the probe below covers the same shape.
- **Path readers, screened.** No script, test, doc or ADR names any of the six by a `sql-driver.ts#…` path, and no test or gate slices their text out of `sql-driver.ts` (the files that read `sql-driver.ts` by path are the five cli `generate-*` pins, `logger-receiver-detach.test.ts`, `sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts` and the gates in the table below; none of them reads these bodies). See Acceptance notes for prose that names them.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1-9 apply it)

- Each class method keeps its docblock and signature, byte-identical less `async`. Its body is now one host literal plus `NAME.call(host, ...)`, marked `[#25521 cut 10]`, and it returns the moved function's own promise.
- Fields and getters go as GETTERS that read the driver at call time: `autoMigrate`, `dialectName`, `driftWarned`, `fileColumnsMoved`, `isSqlite`, `knex`, `logger`, `managedObjectFields`, `managedObjectIndexes`, `mediaFields`, `runtimeCreatedIndexes` and `schemaMode`. Methods go as closures that call the method on the driver at call time. So a subclass override, an instance spy, or a field replaced after construction is still the one the body reaches (see the probe below). `this.logger.info(...)` and `this.logger.warn(...)` still call through the logger itself, as the #12792 comment in `reconcileAndWarnDrift` requires.
- Each moved function types its `this` as the Pick of `SchemaSyncHost` over exactly the members it reads. Each stub annotates its literal as the ThisParameterType of the moved function. There is no cast, and no member becomes public.
- `SchemaSyncHost` gains 18 members, each typed as the class member's indexed access, in the interface's alphabetical order: `applyDriftOpInPlace`, `applyMigrationEntries`, `applyNullSafeUniquePreflight`, `assertSchemaMutable`, `autoMigrate`, `detectTableDrift`, `detectTableIndexDrift`, `driftWarned`, `fileColumnsMoved`, `introspectIndexes`, `isProductionEnv`, `isSqlite`, `isTenantKeyCertified`, `mediaFields`, `rebuildSqliteTablePatched`, `runtimeCreatedIndexes`, `schemaMode` and `varcharColumnChars`.
- **Module-level declarations.**
  - The module now imports from `schema-drift.ts` `carriesNullSafeTenantKeyPart`, `ceremonyOwnedDropFinding`, `diffManagedIndexes`, `diffManagedTable`, `diffUnbuildableIndexes`, `driftKey`, `expectedIndexes`, `indexedKeyColumns`, `isCeremonyOwnedColumnDrop`, `legacyUniqueReplacements` and the type `PhysicalColumn`; from `media-column-move.ts` `isJsonColumnType`, `mediaColumnMoveDialect`, `mediaColumnMovePlan` and the three `MediaColumnMove…` types; `StorageNameMapping` from `@objectstack/spec/system`; and the type `IntrospectedColumn` from `sql-driver.ts` (a type-only import, as the module already does for `SqlDriver`).
  - `sql-driver.ts` drops the 15 of those names it no longer reads (all but `diffManagedIndexes`, `indexedKeyColumns`, `StorageNameMapping`, `IntrospectedColumn` and `MediaColumnMoveScan`, which other code there still reads). `isIndexDriftOp` is one of the 15, because `applyMigrationEntries` was its last reader there.
  - `index.ts` re-exports nothing from the module, so the published surface does not move.
- **Comments.** The module header gains a `[#25521 cut 10]` paragraph that cites no decision letter. The `sql-driver.ts` import comment names cut 10 in 2 lines.
- **How the move was made.** A script produced it from the source text; nothing was retyped. Each body line is re-indented two columns. No line in the moved bodies starts inside template-literal text.

## ADR anchors

`check:adr-anchors` counts decision-letter citations on the anchored surface: each anchor's `invariant`, plus the full text of each anchored file.

- **Both files are anchored.** `sql-driver.ts` has its ADR-0053 entry, and `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts` has the ADR-0120 entry cut 8 created.
- **The citations move between anchored files.** The moved bodies carry their `ADR-0131 D1` and `ADR-0131 D10` citations from one anchored file to the other, and the new header paragraph cites no letter.
- **The count.** It is **1881 decision-letter citations at base `48fba2b178` and at head `5fba834b4`**, over 90 anchored files at both ends. Both runs exit 0.
- **No entry needs a new home.** Neither entry's paragraph describes a moved body: the ADR-0053 paragraph describes `formatOutput` and `presentReadValue`, and the ADR-0120 D4 paragraph describes the tightening ceremony that cuts 8 and 9 moved.

## The published `.d.ts` does not change

This is measured under the series bar (ruling `6348891160`, item 1).

- **How each end was built.** I built each end with `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/driver-sql --force`, against the same dependency tree. The base leg writes the base text of the two source files into this worktree after the commit, under an EXIT/INT/TERM trap that restores HEAD. The restore is proved by the HEAD blob hashes (`d4d08264`, `90b63682`), an empty `git diff HEAD` and 0 status entries.
- **The hashes.** The raw sha256 of `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` is the same at base and at head: `5028e040e1501b0bd72b91fafcf4e1cb372393c59baa5bab8b936b240dd2d3f5` (cut 9's hash). `cmp` finds them identical.
- **Positive control.** I dropped `protected` from `detectTableDrift` in the head `index.d.ts`. The result hashes to `a9d58e424308f85ac7429096c80df2554b41abe53d67410e030799a463072be5`, with a 1-line diff and `cmp` exit 1.
- **Export lists.** CJS `require` and ESM `import` of the built dist give 56 / 56 names at both ends, identical.
- **The head dist carries the move.** `.call(host` sites in `index.mjs` go from 24 at base to 30 at head.

The proof compares TypeScript compiler AST leaf tokens (JSDoc nodes skipped), base `48fba2b178` against head `5fba834b4`. It is a scratch script and is not committed.

| `detectTableIndexDrift` | 149 | 15 | 27 | 6 | 32 |
| `detectManagedDrift` | 239 | 0 | 28 | 6 | 21 |

| `reconcileAndWarnDrift` | 351 | 15 | 17 | 4 | 57 |

- **Each moved body.** In every row, 0 tokens differ and every comment is identical. `async` is on both ends, and there are no type parameters. Each body line is the base line less two leading spaces.
- **The six stubs.** Leading trivia (the docblock), modifiers and the signature are identical to base, less `async`.
- **The class.** It has 348 members at both ends, in the same order, and the 342 unmoved members are byte-identical, trivia included.
- **`sql-driver.ts` top level.** It has 206 statements at both ends. The only base statements that differ are the `schema-drift.js`, `media-column-move.js` and `sql-driver-schema-sync.js` imports, and the class.
- **`sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`.** It goes from 12 to 20 statements. The base statements that differ are the first import (which carries the module header), the `schema-drift.js` and `sql-driver.js` imports, and `SchemaSyncHost`. The new statements are the `@objectstack/spec/system` and `media-column-move.js` imports and the six functions.
- **Result.** `PROOF OK`, exit 0.
- **Negative control.** I changed `could not introspect` to `could not intr0spect` in a module copy. The proof then reports `reconcileAndWarnDrift` with its body tokens and lines differing, prints `PROOF FAILED`, and exits 1.

## Tests

Each end ran under one `os-verify-lock` hold, after building that end's driver-sql dist. I compared the vitest JSON per test name and status, base `48fba2b178` against head `5fba834b4`. Every part's exit code was captured on its own (build, three suites: all 0 at both ends).

| Suite | Base | Head | Lost / changed / added |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `@objectstack/driver-sql` | 4010 (3796 passed, 214 skipped; 248 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| `@objectstack/driver-turso`, against that end's built driver-sql dist | 2526 (2492 passed, 34 skipped; 95 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| `@objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm` | 704 (704 passed; 39 files) | same | 0 / 0 / 0 |

- **Type check and lint.** `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p .` in driver-sql exits 0. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the two touched files exits 0, with 0 problems.
- **Late-binding probe.** This is a scratch script, not committed. It runs node against each end's built dist on in-memory SQLite. Its 27 readings print identical output at base and head (`diff` is empty). They cover:
  1. `detectManagedDrift` reaching a SUBCLASS override of `detectTableDrift` (from the walk and with explicit objects), and `managedObjectFields` replaced on the instance after construction;
  2. `detectTableDrift` reaching instance spies on `introspectColumns` and `detectTableIndexDrift`, with the physical column set and the NOT NULL witness it passes;
  3. `detectTableIndexDrift` reaching instance spies on `introspectIndexes` and `applyNullSafeUniquePreflight` (twice, around a `runtimeCreatedIndexes` entry added on the instance; the index result is empty both times at both ends, so that reading proves the calls, not the ledger read);
  4. `reconcileAndWarnDrift` with `autoMigrate: 'safe'` on a managed schema, through a `logger` and a `driftWarned` replaced after construction: the warn-once lines, the production arm through an instance spy on `isProductionEnv`, and the introspection-failure warning through an instance override of `detectTableDrift`;
  5. `applyMigrationEntries` on SQLite: a destructive entry skipped, the column entries through an instance spy on `rebuildSqliteTablePatched`, an index entry through an instance override of `applyIndexDriftOp`, and the empty set;
  6. `planMediaColumnMove`: a planned `unquote`, `mediaFields` replaced after construction (an absent column refused), and a subclass `dialectName` getter answering the unsupported-dialect refusal;
  7. `detectTableDrift` with `fileColumnsMoved` flipped on the instance (an empty result both ways at both ends on SQLite, so it proves only that the read does not throw);
  8. bad arguments to each moved method answering a rejection (or the same resolution base gives), never a synchronous throw.
- **Not run.** No ablation, because no tested behaviour changed. `test:repo` was not run locally: the diff touches no repo-project test, and CI's Test Core runs it.

## Gates

All local runs are on head `5fba834b4`.

- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 55 commands from the change set against merge base `48fba2b17` (2 paths, 802 changed lines). I captured each exit code before any pipe.
  - 52 exit 0 on the first run.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone, then 0 after `git fetch origin 621a4876` (its positive control).
  - `check:lean-entry-closure` exited 3 with no objectql dist, then 0 after `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/objectql` under the lock.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's dist. It is NOT MEASURED locally, and CI runs it.
- **Reconciliation.** `--ran` reports "55 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 54 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)", exit 0.
- **Lint.** driver-sql has no `lint` script, so I ran the root lint's command scoped to the package: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/drivers/driver-sql`, exit 0.
- **Card-named gates.** I read each at base in a clean detached worktree at `48fba2b178` and at head `5fba834b4`. All exit 0 at both ends, and each prints the same reading at both ends except the one noted.
